title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E04 — Chocolate for the Win
Jesse Palmer asks the nine remaining bakers to create amazing chocolate chip cookie holiday desserts using Ghirardelli chocolate chips; the best dessert is selected by judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh to win a $1,000 prize package.

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S02 E03 — Holiday: Christmas Carolers' Tavern
Host Peck welcomes three Christmas carolers to a historic holiday tavern, where they hunt for six hyperrealistic cakes created by baker April Julian and disguised as everyday objects; can the singing trio end on a high note and win up to $12,000?

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S02 E04 — Holiday: Yuletide Toy Store
Host Josh Peck and cake artist Jose Barajas welcome three busy moms who are expert holiday shoppers; their gift-giving know-how is put to the test as they try to spot the hyperrealistic sweets hidden around a festive holiday toy store to win $12,000!

title: Chopped
description:
S57 E06 — Grand Champs' Holiday Hurrah
Four Grand Champions are headed home to the Chopped kitchen for the holidays; the chefs are challenged with some extremely tough baskets, beginning with a kooky candy cane in the appetizer round.

title: Chopped
description:
S58 E12 — Abalone Absurdities
The chefs are shocked when abalone appears in their appetizer baskets; a fusion soup and a colorful veggie are in the entrée basket, and an unwelcome egg is in the dessert basket.

title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars
description:
S01 E04 — Holiday Feast
Host Wells Adams asks the empires to create hyperrealistic cakes that look like a holiday feast but taste like a decadent dessert; the teams that deliver both illusion and flavor for the judges continue their empire's reign.

title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars
description:
S01 E05 — North Pole Animals
Host Wells Adams challenges the baking teams to create towering showpieces of iconic North Pole animals, like polar bears, walrus and snow owls; judges Yolanda Gampp and Jacques Torres are looking for scale, accuracy and cozy, warm flavors.

title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars
description:
S01 E06 — Finale
In a final showdown, host Wells Adams gives the bakers complete creative freedom to build an entire edible world that celebrates the holiday season; only one empire rises above the rest to claim the $50,000 prize and the crown of Sweet Empire.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E04 — Reindeer's New Hobby
The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E05 — Ugly Sweater Party
Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E06 — Time Travelin' Santa
Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E07 — A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree
Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E08 — North Pole Talent Show
Santa throws a North Pole talent show and the final two teams showcase the secret talents of the town's brave residents; Jeff Mauro, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira crown the champion.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S04 E01 — Holiday Throwdown: Friendsgiving Potluck
Sunny Anderson kicks off the holiday season with a Friendsgiving takedown unlike anything Bobby Flay's ever seen; chefs Damaris Phillips, Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso are serving up festive dishes with a heaping side of revenge.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S05 E02 — Holiday Throwdown: Swim with the Fishes
Guest chefs Tiffani Faison and Gabe Bertaccini dive headfirst into Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson's holiday madness with a chaotic game of Find the Pickle; then, the teams face off in a high-stakes Feast of the Seven Fishes cook-off.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S05 E01 — Holiday Throwdown: There's No Place Like Ham
Bobby and Brooke Williamson welcome guest chefs Damaris Phillips and Viet Pham to kick off the holiday chaos with a spirited game of Spin the Bottle; things get even smokier as the kitchen heats up for a festive, flavor-packed holiday ham showdown.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E05 — Snowed in Sweets
Jesse Palmer asks the teams to make desserts representing snow-day activities for judges Duff Goldman, Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown; the most recent winning team gets to choose either a 15-minute head start or stealing a baker from the other team!

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E06 — Jingle Mingle
Jesse Palmer asks the seven bakers to make a Chrismukkah dessert platter with decorated Christmas cookies, rugelach, and traditional Hanukkah sufganiyot; Judges Duff Goldman, Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown do a blind tasting to decide who wins.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E07 — Retro Christmas
In the semifinals, there are no more teams; Jesse Palmer gives the six remaining bakers a gauntlet of three retro Christmas dessert challenges; guest judge Stephanie Boswell joins Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown to decide which bakers go to the finale.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E08 — Naughty & Nice Christmas
For the finale, Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to make large-scale, over-the-top naughty vs. nice cakes; guest judge Zac Young joins Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown to decide the winner of $25,000.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E07 — Retro Christmas
In the semifinals, there are no more teams; Jesse Palmer gives the six remaining bakers a gauntlet of three retro Christmas dessert challenges; guest judge Stephanie Boswell joins Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown to decide which bakers go to the finale.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E08 — Naughty & Nice Christmas
For the finale, Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to make large-scale, over-the-top naughty vs. nice cakes; guest judge Zac Young joins Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown to decide the winner of $25,000.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E04 — Freak Show of Funnel Cakes
Noah samples funnel cakes from across the country; a funnel cake sundae in Ohio; a maple syrup-drenched funnel-fried bacon in Georgia; funnel cakes featuring pumpkin in Kentucky; apples in Pennsylvania; nacho cheese and jalapeños in California.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E06 — Say Cheese!
Noah dives into some of the cheesiest dishes, both savory and sweet; deep-fried mac and cheese at the Calgary Stampede in Canada; Cowboy Pistolettes in Texas; classic cheese curds in Wisconsin; bacon-covered New York cheesecake.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S24 E10 — Smoked, Grilled and Fried
In Miami, wild boar sausage and house-cured bacon; in Modesto, Calif., tacos and a sweet and savory waffle; in Stockton, Calif., an ex-NFL player slinging wings that score with the sauce.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S25 E08 — Burgers, Buns and Bagels
Guy visits an amped-up deli serving up lamb burgers and ribs; a Koreatown favorite loads up Asian buns and a unique bacon-corn bar dish; a world-class bagel shop spices up their specialty and tops things off with Jersey's famous pork roll.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S25 E06 — Sausage, Seafood and Shawarma
A family pizza-making tradition; griot, snapper and octopus; a spin on street food from around the world.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S26 E08 — From North to South America
Guy Fieri's digs into flavors spanning the Americas; in Charlotte, N.C., a brewery serves the bomb bacon jam burger and a duck confit flatbread; in Cancun, Mexico, a spot serves street tacos; in Houston, a joint cooks up Argentinian empanadas.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S26 E10 — Wonder Women
Guy Fieri tries an all-female lineup; a grandma cooks family recipes like homemade tamales and chile rellenos with a twist in Houston; a spot that makes meatball masterpieces in Orlando, Fla.; a bakery making sweet and savory specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E07 — A Passport of Flavor
In Lansing, shawarma and grape leaves; a Vietnamese barbecue spot serves spring rolls and smokes brisket banh mi; in San Antonio, an authentic Mexican bakery goes old school with their sandwich sourdough and tequila croissants.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E03 — Barbecue, Batter and Beer Can Chicken
Ramen and beer can chicken in Maui; in Los Angeles, a food truck puts a twist on fish and chips; a downtown barbecue spot smokes up the belly and fries up the chicken.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S28 E01 — Mom's Kitchen
Guy Fieri grabs grub straight out of Mom's kitchen; in Boulder, Colo., a mother-son team serve up dan dan noodles and steamed buns; in Columbus, Ohio, a Jamaican joint dishes out jerk chicken; in Arizona, a family spot cooks Latin cuisine.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S28 E17 — East Coast, West Coast
A Palo Alto, Calif., joint serves spicy pork and knockout gnocchi; a bakery-restaurant in Wilmington, N.C., makes major meatloaf and fries up French toast with a fantastic twist; a Puerto Rican party spot in Oakland, Calif., mixes it up with mofongo.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S29 E02 — Sandwiches, Southern and South of the Border
Guy Fieri dives into sandwiches, Southern eats and south-of-the-border specialties; in Spokane, Wash., a lights-out food truck smoking up real-deal barbecue; in Ashland, Ore., a Mexican joint putting a tasty twist on tamales.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: A for Amped-Up Eats
Fieri's diving into amped-up eats that are sure to satisfy. A coastal Georgia joint is putting its spin on Nashville hot chicken with a side of spicy shrimp, while a Vietnamese noodle bar in Calgary is dishing out scratch-made savory street food.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: B for Big-Bite Brunch
Guy Fieri's going from the-bomb breakfast to a taste of Italy! He hits up a brunch bonanza in Columbus, OH, with decadent dulce de leche pancake balls, elevated eats in Boston like rock star rum baba and punchy Parmesan pasta in San Luis Obispo, CA.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: C for Cheesy Crowd-Pleasers
Fieri's getting cheesy and meaty, starting at a South Bound Brook, NJ, meat market stacking up their spin on the sloppy joe. In Nashville,a taco joint is piling nachos with hot local flavor, and a down-home spot is serving the bomb barbecue pork mac.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: D for Daring Dishes
Guy Fieri's digging into some surprising ingredients, from lamb neck in Santa Fe, NM, to duck tongue tacos in Kansas City, MO.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: E for Elevated Everyday Favorites
Guy dives into a serious beef bonanza with scratch-made meaty ravioli in Delaware, an elevated spin on the French dip in San Diego and beefed-up Middle-Eastern fare in El Paso, Texas.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: F for Funky Food Finds
Guy Fieri's grabbing all kinds of funky flavor, starting in Laramie, WY, where a restaurant-bar is pilin' up their nachos, and a longtime spot is cooking up a vegetarian banh mi. Then, a Mexican joint in Alaska is serving dynamite duck tacos.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: G for Guilty-Pleasure Grub
Guy Fieri dives into all kinds of comfort cooking. In Phoenix, he visits a funky joint that's stacking up barbecue fries and putting a new spin on chilaquiles. In Colorado, he stops by a pizza place that's loading up the pies.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: H for Handheld Heroes
Guy Fieri grabs serious sandwiches from an Austin rock-n-roll brunch bar, a Texas joint putting '90s hip hop into their stacked up specialties, and a bakery in Pasco, WA, serving up a killer Cuban and off-the-chain chicken.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: I for Island-Inspired Eats
Guy Fieri is loading up on tropical flavor, starting in a Florida spot serving up lobster enchiladas and lionfish rolls. Then, in Hawaii, a funky food truck is cooking Vietnamese specialties like the bomb banh mi sandwiches and standout spring rolls.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: J for Jam-Packed Joints
Guy Fieri's grabbing all kinds of grub, starting with a Chicago-style spot in Tucson, Ariz., firing up deep-dish pie. In Miami, NFL Coach Jon Gruden's riding shotgun with Guy to a place with out-of-the-box Cuban.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: K for Kooky Kitchen Creations
Guy Fieri is divin' into inventive eats, from a funky joint cooking up mac and cheese pancakes in Burlington, VT, to an artistic eatery in Ottawa, Canada, firin' up spaghetti pizza and putting a colorful spin on the cronut.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: L for Loaded and Legendary
Guy Fieri's digging into joints loadin' it, stuffin' it and fryin' it, from bison-gravy fries and a lamb sandwich in Santa Fe, NM, to outrageous stuffed oysters in Kansas City, KS, and fully loaded potatoes in El Paso, TX.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: M for Mouthwatering Mashups
Guy digs into a variety of flavor fusions from a Latin-Asian mashup in Chicago and a Nashville hot chicken joint in Seattle to a Hawaiian spot that mixes the island with the mainland.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: N for Neighborhood Knockouts
Guy Fieri's hanging out at mom-and-pop spots, like a family-run Indian joint hooked up to a gas station in Logan, UT. He stops at a dumpling house in Vermont and a Denver landmark where Mom's cookin' up Caribbean-soul favorites.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: O for Over-the-Top Eats
Fieri dives into a meaty smorgasbord, starting with a funky Nashville joint that serves a skyscraper burger.Then in New Smyrna Beach, Florida, a rockin' chef cooks up real deal gnocchi and an out-of-this-world spot goes huge with a monster pork chop.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: P for Prime-Time Plates
Guy Fieri's hitting up joints owned by Food Network super chefs, like Maneet Chauhan, who is serving up her creative spin on Indian recipes in Nashville. Then, in Cleveland, Guy joins Michael Symon, firing up pork belly at his barbecue spot.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: Q for Quintessential Comfort
Fieri's digging creative home-cooked comfort, starting with savory scones in Somerville, MA.Then, an Ohio distillery is serving elevated eats like barbacoa nachos, and a soul food spot in Indianapolis is plating a killer collard green grilled cheese.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: R for Rockin' Recipes
Guy Fieri dives into all kinds of amazing Latin specialties from primo Peruvian sandwiches in Miami and Panamanian flavors in North Carolina to a joint in Tucson, AZ, putting a funky fresh spin on tacos and carne asada.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: S for Spicy Sensations
Guy Fieri's grabbing sandwiches, spice and everything nice, starting with lights-out lamb in Fargo, ND. A funky spot in Sioux Falls, SD, is loading up hand-held flavor bombs, and, in Fairbanks, AK, a wild pizza place is making spicy, sweet pies.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: T for Taste-Bud Takeover
Fieri's grabbing fistfuls of flavor at a California spot bringing next-level Mediterranean to the West Coast. Then, a New Jersey bistro by the beach is slingin' herbaceous octopus, and an Indianapolis Argentine joint is firing up chimichurri chorizo.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: U for Unforgettable Upgrades
Guy's digging into crazy twists on chicken and burgers including doctored-up chicken skins in Delaware, shawarma-stuffed sausages in San Diego and hearty walnut burgers in Vancouver.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: V for Vintage Vibes
This trip is a classic, comfort-filled joyride for Guy Fieri. He finds mozzarella sticks and gravy fries at a retro diner in Leavenworth, WA, home-style fried chicken and grits in Draper, UT, and stellar meatless chorizo at a vegan spot in Nashville.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: W for Worth-the-Trip Eats
Guy Fieri heads to Fairbanks for an Alaskan culinary adventure. There are authentic German specialties at a super funky food truck, a food-and-music jam-fest featuring Cuban favorites and a local hot spot servin' up comfort with meatball subs.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: X for X Marks the Flavor
Guy Fieri takes a detour to find some not-your-everyday eats. In Richmond, VA, a Jamaican joint is serving oxtail and fried chicken with island flavor, and in Reno, NV, a sandwich spot puts a unique twist on the breakfast burrito.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: Y for Year-Round Yummies
Fieri's diggin' into not-your-everyday dishes, all day long. In Taos, NM, there's a stacked-up breakfast, unique pot pie and Mexican recipes not found on a typical menu. Then, skate legend Tony Hawk tags along for creative vegan cooking in San Diego.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: Z for Zero-to-Hero Dishes
Fieri's sampling fresh takes on traditional dishes, starting with craveable carnitas ramen in Austin, TX. A funky joint in Cincinnati is plating prime-time pulled pork poutine, and a Thai spot in Los Angeles is serving up sorbet with a tom-yum twist.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S29 E01 — From Pork to Pasta
Guy Fieri digs into everything from pork to pasta on this trip; in Chicago, a real-deal Italian spot with righteous ravioli and dynamite deep dish; an authentic Hong Kong barbecue experience served alongside all the classics.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S28 E18 — Italian, Hawaiian and Colombian
In Hawaii, a poke place knocks it out of the park with their island specialties; a crazy Italian spot in San Carlos, Calif., puts tasty twists on their homemade pasta; a Latin joint in Miami serves up killer Colombian specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S28 E07 — Rollin' in the Dough
In Mesa, Ariz., a Hawaiian joint serves island specialties, including a meaty bun; in Tucson, Ariz., a place cooks up a saucy sandwich and spinach dip calzone; in Miami, Fla., a shop makes artisan doughnuts and turns pastries into savory sandwiches.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E13 — College-Town Champs
Guy's rolling into college towns; in Columbus, Ohio, a pierogi paradise dishing out their specialties and a barbecue truck smoking premiere pork; in Boulder, Colorado, a legit Thai joint serving knockout noodles and off-the-chain chicken.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E09 — Old Faces, New Places
Visiting familiar Triple D faces and checking out their new places; pizza joint in Flagstaff; a seafood place in Fairhope; in Miami, a chef dials up the funk factor with his spin on Chinese specialties like dandan noodles.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S26 E09 — Goin' International
A Jamaican joint serves oxtail and curry goat in Houston; a Lebanese stop serves kibbie balls and kabobs; in Cancun, Mexico, a 24-hour hot spot makes bomb burritos.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S26 E06 — Kickin' It In Cancun
Guy Fieri heads to Cancun; an authentic, family-owned spot serving rellenos and chicharron gorditas; an underground spot pairing urban art with dishes like pork and seared tuna; an inside look at Guy's Playa del Carmen restaurant.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S25 E12 — Brunch, Bologna and Burgers
Guy Fieri visits a place in Louisville, Ky., that serves lamb grits and fried bologna; a burger joint cooks up a pork belly Cuban and killer veggie burger; a diner-restaurant with donut sliders and chicken and waffles with a kick in Portland, Ore.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E12 — Hot Doggin'
Host Noah Cappe travels to festivals and fairs across the country in search of frankly delicious dogs; a crab dip smothered dog in Maryland; a cheesy, spicy chile relleno dog in California; dessert dogs covered in whipped cream and chocolate.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E14 — Everything's Better With Bacon
Noah Cappe travels from festivals to fairs across the country to seek out some of the best bacon dishes around.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S03 E12 — Miss Brown's Birthday!
On her birthday, Kardea Brown cooks for two of her favorite ladies, Momma Pat and Aunt TC; she makes Carolina she-crab soup, red wine-braised beef short ribs atop creamy sweet potato polenta and a Southern tradition, hummingbird cake.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S04 E09 — Gal's Night In
Kardea Brown makes some comfort classics for her friends, including maple BBQ chicken and sweet potato waffles with fried green tomatoes; for dessert, Kardea bakes espresso brownies with a mocha ganache that will keep the party warm and cozy.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S08 E12 — Housewarming Party
For a housewarming party, Kardea Brown makes buttery lobster rolls, coconut shrimp with fruit salsa, a summer pasta salad with grilled okra, corn and peppers, a layered dessert of strawberry shortbread trifles.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S10 E12 — How Does Her Garden Grow
Kardea Brown throws a garden party for her girlfriends, showcasing locally grown ingredients; she prepares Creamy Leek and Steak Pasta, Low Country Style Shrimp Toasts with House Pickled Okra, Mixed Berry Crumble and White Sangria.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S18 E08 — Easy Entertaining
Ree hosts a cooking and eating get-together with her Oklahoma City Thunder gal friends; white spinach artichoke lasagna with a butternut and kale salad; the party continues with Thunder margaritas in the team colors and boozy berries and cream.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S35 E08 — Hard Hat Party at the Ranch
Ree Drummond's favorite women are visiting her new house; she makes mini pineapple shrimp tostadas and bacon-wrapped baby potatoes for bite-sized apps before whipping up boozy chocolate trifles and blackberry blood orange mojitos.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S36 E10 — Quick and Easy Party Faves
Ree Drummond is all about fast and fabulous party food for easy entertaining; she prepares delicious Herby Mediterranean meatballs, an incredible Cajun shrimp cocktail, spicy jalapeño cheeseburger wontons and sophisticated rum balls.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S37 E02 — Hosting on a Dime
Ree Drummond cooks budget-friendly food for entertaining, including French beef bourguignon, salmon cakes, fried olives and toasted coconut puddings.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S16 E11 — Have the Best Birthday
Katie makes porterhouse steak with herb fries; Geoffrey's shrimp bruschetta and Sunny's mini pita pizzas prove to be fun finger foods for any occasion; baker Melissa Ben-Ishay creates birthday magic with a tie-dye birthday cake.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S30 E01 — Big Game Party Playbook
"The Kitchen" hosts have play-by-play rules for hosting the perfect big game party, including a new spin on buffalo chicken enchiladas, spicy salami mozzarella sticks and a brewsky sour.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description:
S01 E04 — Bake and Take
Danielle Sepsy breaks down the key techniques that create Thin and Crispy Chocolate Chip Cookies versus Soft and Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies. Then, she makes rich, fudgy Unboxed Brownies that deliver bakery-quality results without a mix.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description:
S01 E03 — From Produce to Pastry
Transforming everyday fruits and vegetables into comforting, bakery-style treats; first, creating a Best Carrot Cake, layering moist cake with tangy cream cheese frosting; then, ripe bananas become soft, sweet Sugar Cookie Banana Bread.

Host Josh Peck and cake artist Jose Barajas welcome three busy moms who are expert holiday shoppers; their gift-giving know-how is put to the test as they try to spot the hyperrealistic sweets hidden around a festive holiday toy store to win $12,000!

Host Peck brings holiday decorating fanatics Victor, Joe and Heidi to a big holiday decor warehouse, where cake artist Liz Marek has hidden six hyperrealistic cakes among the seasonal trimmings; if the trio can spot all six, they win $12,000!

Host Peck welcomes three Christmas carolers to a historic holiday tavern, where they hunt for six hyperrealistic cakes created by baker April Julian and disguised as everyday objects; can the singing trio end on a high note and win up to $12,000?

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S02 E01 — Holiday: Christmas Tree Lane
Host Josh and cake artist Ashley Holt welcome a principal-turned-Santa and two helpers to a house on Christmas Tree Lane; their holiday knowledge is tested as they try to spot which holiday items are real and which are secret treats to win $12,000!

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E01 — Winter Wonderland
Casey Webb challenges three teams of Christmas bakers to create fantasy snow globe cakes that capture the magic and joy of the holidays; each team uses ice sculpture to enhance the glitz and glam of their display and impress the judges.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E02 — Mrs. Claus' Night Off
Casey Webb challenges three teams of master holiday bakers and their ice sculptors to show off a new side of Santa's better half in out-of-this-world cake designs and displays.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E04 — Santa's Christmas Eve
The three remaining baking teams and their ice sculptors must create the ultimate "Night Before Christmas" cake display featuring Santa.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E03 — Manufacturing Mishap
Christmas is coming, so Jeff Mauro tasks three teams of cake, sugar and cookie artists with illustrating a terrible mistake in Santa's workshop; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira choose whose mishap earns a pass and who won't be getting a holiday bonus.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E04 — Holiday Parade
The six remaining teams face off as Jeff Mauro tasks them with creating the holiday tradition of a parade float; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide which team has the most festive float and who drives home.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E05 — Christmas Card Craziness
Jeff Mauro challenges the teams to create a scene capturing the moment a holiday photo goes wrong, while highlighting their cookie artist skills; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira cut one team out of the picture.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E06 — Christmas Under the Sea
To celebrate "Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom," host Jeff Mauro asks the teams to imagine what holidays look like under the sea and incorporate underwater plant life made entirely of sugar.

description:
S05 E07 — Kids Catch Santa
Jeff Mauro challenges the three remaining teams to reveal what will happen when the kids finally catch Santa while he's delivering their toys.

The last two teams standing take Christmas light displays to the next level by creating large-scale illuminated structures; Jeff Mauro, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira determine who will be crowned Holiday Wars champion and win the $25,000 prize.

title: Bathroom Makeover
description: Transform your bath affordably in just one day!

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S07 E01 — Allison Janney
Allison Janney joins Ina Garten at the barn for a day of conversation and a cooking lesson; Ina welcomes Allison with baked fontina, a spin on a childhood favorite, and shares the secrets to making perfect cacio e pepe and lemon vinaigrette.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S07 E04 — Michael Barbaro
Journalist Michael Barbaro joins Ina Garten for Spicy Hermit Bars and conversation about storytelling tactics, style and the success of his podcast "The Daily"; Ina shows Michael an updated Chicken Marbella that's perfect for easy entertaining.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E01 — Christina Tosi
Pastry chef and Milk Bar founder Christina Tosi joins Ina Garten to share stories about life-changing career decisions and dessert revelations; Ina makes Smoked Salmon Tartines, and Christina shares the secrets to Milk Bar's legendary Birthday Cake.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E04 — Yotam Ottolenghi
Garten welcomes award-winning chef Dan Barber for lively conversation about catering coincidences, high-pressure hospitality, and redefining restaurant reviews. Plus, Ina makes Cornmeal Pound Cake, and Dan shares his recipe for Miso Crusted Squash.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S09 E05 — Office Warming Party
A celebration of a new office opening includes a shrimp cocktail bar with three sauces: avocado crema, classic cocktail and remoulade, spicy Italian meatballs, bacon wrapped dates and sweet brownie pops.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S34 E10 — Easy Dinner Party Inspiration
Ree prepares impressive dinner entrées including seared strip steak with jalapeño cream sauce, one-pan garlic butter shrimp penne, lighter braised greens and make-ahead tiramisu cheesecake cups.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S33 E08 — Housewarming Treats
Ree Drummond prepares fall sweets for visitors at her and her sister's remodeled home, by starting the housewarming with her classic s'mores cookies, shortcut cherry cheesecake brownie cups, easy apple fritters, and pumpkin pie snacking granola.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S38 E13 — Portable Dinner Party
Ree cooks for a dinner party at her best friend's house, starting with Roasted Jalapeño Pimento Cheese; the main course is Baked Sausage and Peppers Bucatini, plus Hearty Citrus Salad; for dessert, Ree whips up decadent Espresso Cream Poke Cake.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description:
S01 E04 — Bake and Take
Danielle Sepsy breaks down the key techniques that create thin and crispy chocolate chip cookies versus soft and chewy chocolate chip cookies; she makes rich, fudgy unboxed brownies that deliver bakery-quality results without a mix.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description:
S01 E01 — Best Sellers
Danielle Sepsy shares two items from her bakery, The Hungry Gnome; she makes cherry vanilla bean scones, then bakes blueberry crumb muffins topped with a buttery streusel.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S13 E05 — Celebrate Good Times
Katie Lee makes surf and turf skewers; Tregaye Fraser with two easy chicken recipes; Sunny Anderson makes a dessert pizza; Geoffrey Zakarian makes key lime pie punch; Marcy Blum shares the latest party trends; Marcela Valladolid makes a photo booth.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S32 E13 — Dinner Party on a Dime
Throwing a dinner party without breaking the bank; Katie Lee Biegel makes an aromatic lemon garlic chicken; Jeff Mauro turns a budget staple into rum raisin rice pudding; Geoffrey Zakarian shakes up a Hemingway daiquiri.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S33 E13 — Top Notch Tea Party
The Kitchen preps tea party food that's perfect for any celebration; Sunny Anderson whips up her easy asparagus and tomato quiche, Alex Guarnaschelli serves up cornmeal scones, and Geoffrey Zakarian tops off the tea tower with millionaire bars.
